commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize weave workspace files and probe GDC integration
commands.descriptionEn: Initialize weave workspace files and probe GDC integration

commands.name: map
commands.description: 코드베이스 구조 분석 + GDC 그래프 연동
commands.descriptionEn: Analyze codebase structure via GDC + Graphify (knowledge graph)

args.name: deep
args.description: Run deep analysis with graphify-windows skill

commands.name: interview
commands.description: 코드베이스 맵 기반 멀티스텝 요구사항 인터뷰
commands.descriptionEn: Multi-step question asking until clarity, with structural change detection

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: research + spec + plan을 한 번에 생성 (큰 계획은 자동 분할)
commands.descriptionEn: Create research + spec + plan with defaults (auto-splits oversized plans)

args.name: splitPlans
args.description: Auto-split oversized plans into multiple shard plan files

args.name: splitMaxPhases
args.description: Max phases per shard when splitPlans is enabled

args.name: splitMaxHours
args.description: Max estimated hours per shard when splitPlans is enabled

commands.name: refine-plan
commands.description: Apply structured plan-note directives to active plan
commands.descriptionEn: Apply structured plan-note directives to active plan

args.name: notesPath
args.description: Path to structured plan notes (default: tasks/plan-notes.md)

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Plan 승인 게이트 통과 (구현 전 필수)
commands.descriptionEn: Approve the plan, or finalize a crafted phase when phaseId is provided

commands.name: craft
commands.description: 단일 Phase 수동 실행 준비 (실행 컨텍스트 생성)
commands.descriptionEn: Prepare execution context for a phase (phase auto-select if omitted)

args.name: projectType
args.description: Project type hint (react, nextjs, go, etc.)

commands.name: build
commands.description: 자율 빌드 루프 실행 및 관리
commands.descriptionEn: Autonomous build loop — run, resume, or inspect builds

args.name: phaseIds
args.description: Comma-separated phase IDs for run action

args.name: maxRetries
args.description: Maximum retries per task (for run action)

args.name: maxNoProgress
args.description: Maximum repeated no-progress failures before blocking

commands.name: status
commands.description: 전체 플랜 목록 + 진행 상황 확인

commands.name: worktree
commands.description: git worktree 기반 병렬 작업 관리
commands.descriptionEn: Manage git worktrees for parallel work

args.name: fromRef
args.description: Base git ref to branch from

commands.name: verify
commands.description: 빌드/테스트 검증 실행 (프로젝트 유형 자동 감지)
commands.descriptionEn: Run build/test verification for current worktree

commands.name: archive
commands.descriptionEn: Archive the verified active change artifact

commands.name: troubleshoot
commands.description: 글로벌 지식 검색 및 솔루션 기록
commands.descriptionEn: Search global knowledge for solutions or record a new one

args.name: error
args.description: Error message to search solutions for

args.name: record
args.description: Record a new solution instead of searching

examples: weave command=troubleshoot record=true solution="Restart dev server"

commands.name: repair
commands.description: plan YAML 파일 자동 검사 및 수리
commands.descriptionEn: Scan and auto-repair corrupted plan YAML files

commands.name: agents
commands.description: 에이전트 파일 동기화 및 설정 초기화
commands.descriptionEn: Sync dummy-human agent files and initialize configuration

args.name: sync
args.description: Force regenerate agent .md files from config pool

args.name: init
args.description: Create default maskweaver.config.json with pool template
